families.description: Data bundle purchase. The ONLY plausible Airtel Money Kenya capture found in public (demo data in a public messaging-app repo with the address recorded as AirtelMoney; numeric transaction id, 'Fee: … Bal: …' labels). Every other Airtel Money family has no sample at all (corpus/airtel-money/MISSING-FAMILIES.md), so this pack has one family at low confidence until a real export arrives. Source: corpus/airtel-money/unverified-public-samples.jsonl.
families.pattern: ^(?<externalRef>[A-Z0-9]{6,14})\s*Confirmed\.\s*You have successfully purchased a bundle of Ksh\s?(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) via (?<counterpartyName>.+?) on (?<occurredAt>\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2,4}\s+at\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*[AP]M)\.\s*Fee:\s*Ksh\s?(?<fee>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\.\s*Bal:\s*Ksh\s?(?<balanceAfter>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)

examples.body: XXXXXXXX234 Confirmed. You have successfully purchased a bundle of Ksh 500 via Airtel Networks Kenya Ltd on 09/03/26 at 08:03 AM. Fee: Ksh 0. Bal: Ksh 1,200.00
